event_description:
The 6th edition of Free and Open Source Software Festival by the FOSS United community.


IndiaFOSS is an annual Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) festival, organised with passion and commitment by the FOSS United community. It's not just a gathering; it's a celebration of software innovation and the people who make it happen. Whether you are a seasoned developer, an aspiring enthusiast, or someone with a passion for technology, IndiaFOSS invites you to be part of this vibrant community.

schedule_page_description:
Note that this is a **DRAFT** schedule. IndiaFOSS is a busy conference, with almost 150 sessions overall, happening in parallel across 6 places: 3 halls (all in the ground floor) and 3 rooms (all in the first floor). The General Track, featuring an assortment of sessions covering FOSS and the Digital Commons, runs in Hall 1 (900 seats) and Hall 2 (250 seats). Devrooms are half day mini-conferences organized by independent communities, focussing on specific topics. These run in Hall 3 (120 seats) and Room 1 (120 seats). Apart from this, Birds of a Feather(BoF) sessions happen in Rooms 2 and 3, each 35 seats. Here's an overview of the sessions. A detailed list of sessions for every hall/room follows the table.

ticket_form_description:
- The sixth edition of Free and Open Source Software Festival by the FOSS United community.

- **T-shirt** is available at discounted price of Rs 600 right now for you to add to your ticket.

- We offer financial support for attendees from underrepresented communities through our diversity scholarship (applications closed). We also provide [accessibility](https://fossunited.org/indiafoss/accessibility/new) and [childcare](https://fossunited.org/indiafoss/childcare/new) support during the event, fill the forms if you need either.

- If you're in a position to support someone else's attendance, consider [contributing to the diversity fund](https://rzp.io/rzp/fMSIgnmJ). [Read more](https://forum.fossunited.org/t/diversity-support-is-back-for-indiafoss-2026/8499).

- Check [Ticket count stats](https://fossunited.org/indiafoss/2026/stats)

- IndiaFOSS conference tickets **do not provide access to Workshops on 25th September**. [Tickets for workshops](https://fossunited.org/c/indiafoss/2026/workshops) need to be purchased separately.

- Please reach out to us at **[indiafoss@fossunited.org](mailto:indiafoss@fossunited.org)** for any queries.
